observations: Personally opened this current-source original PNG. Status dot, expiry date, days-left text and remove action share centered rows; no text or control crosses the dialog boundary.
Type, Date, Quantity and Lot labels align over filled controls; Add matches the field height. Phone wraps the group into two rows with Add below.
framingLimits: The dialog scroll is framed on Date tracking; sections above the visible viewport are not all shown.

observations: Personally opened this current-source original PNG. The complete red missing-date helper is readable within its field group, including above the phone sticky footer.
Cancel and Save product remain contained; invalid date field is visible in the scrolled Dates section.
framingLimits: What’s missing above this scrolled viewport and blocked-save behavior are checked separately by executed browser tests.

observations: Personally opened this current-source original PNG. All 16 product records and their dividers are within the full-height list card; code, offer and end-aligned selling-price columns fit at desktop and 900 px.
Checkboxes remain separate controls; bilingual names, current Sale price and crossed regular price are contained. Sidebar has a full-height background; no rows spill out.
framingLimits: Sticky behavior and selection interactions require the separate browser checks.
